function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time weather data. If you’d like, I can give you a general idea of what the temperature in Tel Aviv tends to be around this time of year, or I can help you find a reliable source where you can check the current temperature in Fahrenheit.

We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. But maybe we can use a weather API? There's no tool for that. We can respond that we don't have real-time data.
